sections.body: Write a program that reads a number of sides and prints Triangle, Quadrilateral, Pentagon, Big Polygon above 5, or Not Polygon below 3.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It maps 3, 4 and 5 to names, treats anything above 5 as Big Polygon, and everything else as Not Polygon.
